skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 800% ATK as Direct DMG to enemies within a cross-shaped area and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 rounds. Reduces all enemies’ [Specialized Resilience Rate] by 30% and increases all allies’ [Specialized Resilience Rate] by 30%. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrosion] on the main target. [Lock]: Prevents [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 150% ATK [Lock] DoT (can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded]). [Specialized Corrosion]: Deals Continuous DMG equal to 300% ATK. Disappears after triggering 10 times. After any character acts, transfers to a target that can receive DMG. [Specialized Resilience Rate]: Affects the amount of DMG that [Specialized Resilience] can absorb for each Shield point.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1100% ATK as Direct DMG to enemies within a cross-shaped area and has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies for 2 rounds. Reduces all enemies’ [Specialized Resilience Rate] by 50% and increases all allies’ [Specialized Resilience Rate] by 50%. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Corrosion] on the main target. [Lock]: Prevents [Follow-Up], [Continuous Follow-Up], and [Combo Follow-Up]. Before any character acts, deals 200% ATK [Lock] DoT (can CRIT and cannot be [Evaded]). [Specialized Corrosion]: Deals Continuous DMG equal to 300% ATK. Disappears after triggering 10 times. After any character acts, transfers to a target that can receive DMG. [Specialized Resilience Rate]: Affects the amount of DMG that [Specialized Resilience] can absorb for each Shield point.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Reduces [Continuous Explosion DMG] received by all allies by 60%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Reduces [Continuous Explosion DMG] received by all allies by 70%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Reduces [Continuous Explosion DMG] received by all allies by 80%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, all allies gain [Specialized Resilience] equal to 100% of their own Max HP. Before any character acts, 4 random enemies receive [True DMG] equal to 100% of the original total [Lock] DMG. [Specialized Resilience]: Absorbs DMG equal to 100% of the affected unit’s Max HP. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, all allies gain [Specialized Resilience] equal to 150% of their own Max HP. Before any character acts, 4 random enemies receive [True DMG] equal to 150% of the original total [Lock] DMG. At battle start, has a 100% chance to inflict [Lock] on all enemies, dealing 100% ATK DMG for 1 turn. [Specialized Resilience]: Absorbs DMG equal to 150% of the affected unit’s Max HP. [True DMG]: Not affected by DMG Rate or DMG Free and deals Direct DMG without [DMG Sharing] or [Evasion].

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage equal to 100% of the wearer's Maximum Health.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
